description: IRIS CLI scaffold manifest. The installer fetches this file from GitHub raw (or heyiris.io when configured), then downloads each entry to the user's ~/.iris/ directory. Adding a new how-to is just a PR adding the file + a line here.

files.purpose: Top-level rules file. Loaded into every session by packages/opencode/src/session/system.ts. Keep small (~500 tokens) — it points to how-to/ for deep content.
Index of all how-to recipes. The agent lists this directory and reads README.md to find the right recipe.

Loop engineering — build a self-running goal→discover→plan→execute→verify→ship loop on IRIS (agents + bloq memory + hive parallelism + weekly schedule + eval verify). The IRIS mapping, a worked store-growth build, 4 use cases, and an honest list of what's not first-class yet.
NDAs, BAAs, multi-party signing, and gating access on an executed agreement. Distinct from payment-gate-contracts, which sells rather than gates.

Link bloqs together — relations, filtering, and the graph view

The hunter's path on /p/bounty-dashboard — email gate, apply with signup folded in, agreements raised on acceptance, self-serve payouts. The person-facing counterpart to bug-bounty (money states) and agreements-and-signing (operator side).

Build a certification: course, chapters, study material and quiz, and how the resulting certificate gates who gets paid on a bounty. Covers what makes a chapter examinable and how required_certification_course_id holds a payout.

Sending and logging communications: iMessage, Apple Mail, sender identities, email signatures, and the send/bounce rails. Read before any outreach send — it covers what is logged, what is not, and which channels cannot be tracked at all.

Reading a -V / -VV chat trace: iterations, tool calls with their arguments, tool results with status AND size, and the model behind each decision. Carries what --help cannot — the three failures a trace separates (tool never offered / tool ran and returned nothing / model ignored the result), only the last of which is a model problem.
Diagnose 5 common install failure modes: baseline asset mismatch, macOS version floor, missing deps, scaffold fetch fail, branding. Includes quick diagnostic command to send users.
Recover the Elon frontend from a Railway build-lock race

Daily diary — read/write your account-scoped diary and publish local daily-diary/*.md into it with `iris diary sync` (idempotent, date-deduped, frontmatter writeback). Scopes (user/agent/bloq), opt-in --public sharing, and the auth/owner-scoping security model.
Capture and manage investor interest on marketplace opportunities — the dual-sided opportunity flow (workers apply, investors fund).
Master index for curating the Discover page — all CLI surfaces (sponsors, streamers, producers, instrumentals, opportunities, tutorials, investments) with links to deeper recipes and known gaps.

Who can see a Genesis page and how to lock one down. The gating model is TWO independent settings (requires_auth for the login gate, visibility private to kill the public /p/ urls) plus a cache purge before either takes effect — the step whose absence makes the other two look broken. Also: inspect a draft with `genesis get`, never by publishing it, and offer preview/share links before publish.

Pulse readiness engine — autonomous 4-signal scoring (requirements + liveness + comms freshness + config), 15-min cron, daily digest. How to enroll a lead, view the score, run requirements, debug the loop.

Infrastructure recipe. Put their machine on a personal tailnet, connect to it over that, and you can help them without them having to do anything except turn the computer on. The whole job is three decisions — which tailnet, which remote-control tool, and who is at the keyboard for the first five minutes — and getting…

Content & Media recipe. Creates a brand entity with one or more personas (voice/tone profiles). Each persona can have its own system prompt, hashtags, style guidelines, and AI settings. Used for the multi-persona content engine (e.g., 6 IG accounts, each a different finance archetype).

Put a client's Atlas data on their own PostgreSQL or S3 bucket (Provider Proxy) - bind the workspace, then migrate the objects. Covers data residency, the refusals, and why a bad binding stays silent.
Finance recipe. Record revenue, expenses, and transfers using the Atlas ledger. Set up a chart of accounts for proper categorization. View summaries and prepare for QuickBooks sync.
How a playbook holds human SOPs (Atlas items, attached by reference) alongside agent skills — iris playbook items/roles. The container shipped long before anyone could find it.
Chaining playbooks — a step can run another playbook (mode: playbook). Worked since the executor shipped with zero usage because nothing said it was possible.

Canonical reference loopable playbook (the 'fuel' for `iris loop run`). A v2 implement→verify loop — orchestrator → Builder/Scout/Growth → verify → synthesize → memory — whose verify step emits `VERDICT: SHIP|ITERATE` so the loop engine (platform-loop.ts) terminates correctly. Resolves `iris playbook show agentic-loop` and `iris loop run agentic-loop --until SHIP`, which the agentic-loops.md how-to points at.

Runnable SOP for the Hive + Tailscale secure mesh — onboard a machine, lock it down with a least-privilege ACL, connect, enroll it as a Hive node, and diagnose bottom-up. Companion to the hive-tailscale how-to, which explains the model; this is the half you run.
